explication: asdf is a per-project runtime-version manager exposed through one CLI and extended by language plugins. The main flow is command invocation, configuration and version selection, then plugin-driven install or executable dispatch through generated shims. The graph also preserves plugin discovery, shell completion, legacy-version support, and execution helpers documented or referenced by the source index. Edges reflect visible imports/calls or README capabilities; unsampled implementation details are omitted rather than inferred.
